scripts.build: bun run build:physics && tsc --noEmit && bun --bun vite build
scripts.test: bun run check:architecture && bun run check:physics && bun test --timeout 120000 tests/simulation/core.test.ts tests/simulation/tasks-framework.test.ts tests/simulation/partition.test.ts tests/simulation/sized.test.ts tests/simulation/height.test.ts tests/simulation/head-camera.test.ts tests/simulation/whole-body.test.ts tests/simulation/actuator.test.ts tests/simulation/physics-feedback.test.ts tests/simulation/body-tower.test.ts tests/simulation/body-partition.test.ts tests/simulation/body-height.test.ts tests/simulation/body-trajectory.test.ts tests/simulation/teacher-optimization.test.ts tests/simulation/placement-verification.test.ts tests/runtime/planning-scheduling.test.ts tests/runtime/host-pacing.test.ts tests/runtime/host-wire.test.ts
scripts.check:browser: bun tests/web/browser.ts && bun tests/web/themes.ts && bun tests/web/head-camera.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts configs vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts configs vite.config.ts
scripts.check:ui: bun tests/web/ui.ts && bun tests/web/ui-language.ts && bun tests/web/ui-pacing.ts && bun tests/web/ui-responsiveness.ts
scripts.check:policy: bun test tests/runtime/policy-contract.test.ts && uv run --project policy pytest policy/tests -q && bun tests/runtime/policy.ts
scripts.check:tasks: bun tests/simulation/partition-teacher.ts && bun tests/simulation/sized-teacher.ts && bun tests/simulation/height-teacher.ts
scripts.check:physics: bun run build:physics && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=.tmp/physics/target RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native' cargo test --release --locked -p stackling-physics
scripts.preview: bun run build:physics && bun --bun vite preview --host 127.0.0.1
